class: a pin whose commit is there and whose path is not

expect.why: the ground pins a path at a commit made before that path existed — a file added later, or renamed since. The pointer fails exactly as it does when the commit itself is gone, and the near-negative of D54: the repair here is one pin on one entry, where a missing commit is a supersession per entry, so a checker that reported the two the same way would send a person the wrong distance

history: apply commits/01, commits/02, … as successive commits in a fresh repository; expectations name the commit they apply to. `@commitNN` in an entry is substituted with the real short object id of that commit before it is made, because a seed cannot know an id the runner has not created yet
